# Nextup

> A self-hosted tracker for the TV shows and films you watch. It records which
> episodes you have seen, works out which one is next, says when the next
> episode airs, and says when a film is released. It runs
> on your own server and sends nothing anywhere except requests to TheTVDB
> and, if you turn on the morning email, to your own mail server.

Nextup is free software published by Lightmorphic Ltd under the GNU General
Public Licence version 3. There is no hosted version, no account to create and
no paid tier. You install it yourself with Docker.

## What it does

- Next up: every aired episode you have not watched, newest first by default, with a switch to oldest first.
- Marking watched: one episode, a whole season, or everything up to a chosen episode.
- Calendar and Coming soon: when your shows air, over 14 to 180 days.
- Maybe list: shows and films you are curious about, kept out of Next up.
- Films: split into ready to watch, coming soon, and seen, using each film's release date.
- Morning email: what became watchable overnight, sent through your own mail server at a time you choose.
- Episode pages: still, synopsis, air date and runtime.
- Show and film pages: cast with photographs, genres, trailer and IMDb links.

## What it does not do

- It does not play, stream or download video, and links to no source of it.
- It has one account and one watch history. It is not multi-user.
- It has no push notifications, and no import from another tracker.
- It is not hosted for you. You run it or you do not use it.

## Requirements

Docker. There is nothing to sign up for: Nextup looks shows and films up on
TheTVDB through a service run by Lightmorphic.
